deploy-bot: Starting rollout r-8942 — unpin runtime v2.4 for model redwood/gptx-small on Dedicated pools. Change window 2026-03-21 23:00-01:00 PDT. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated health checks.

olivia: quick q — why unpin now? we hit a kv-cache mismatch on canary yesterday, right? :eyes:

amar: correct. v2.4 changed KV layout + kernel ordering. Older pinned runtimes (v2.3) can't consume the new cache blobs. Need unpin so the runtime can select updated kernels. Plan: slow canary + synthetic probes. rollback criteria: latency >1.2x baseline OR error rate >0.5%.

jen: can we exempt enterprise customer-x from the unpin? they asked to stay on stable v2.3 for the weekend.

kevin: we have a pin-exempt mechanism. example edit command:```bash
# remove cluster-level pin but keep customer-x on v2.3
deployctl pinlist edit --model redwood/gptx-small --remove-pin v2.3 --exempt "customer-x"
```Note: run from release-admin, will prompt for confirmation.

sre-bob: adding synthetic probe set promptset/kv-regress to the canary group now. will alert if top-10 latency or failure count spikes.

olivia: ack. i'll add the calendar change window and post a short note to #incidents before the start. tagging @oncall for coverage.

oncall: I'm on for the window. will watch alerts and can run manual rollback steps if needed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary reached 50% on pool-gpu-5 and pool-gpu-6. quick summary:
- pool-gpu-5: mean latency 1.50x baseline, errors +0.4%
- pool-gpu-6: mean latency 1.05x baseline, errors +0.1%
Auto-policy: latency spike threshold breached on pool-gpu-5 (1.5x > 1.2x) — initiating automatic rollback for affected hosts. Rolling pinned runtime v2.3 back onto pool-gpu-5. Rollout r-8942 paused at 50%.

sre-bob: confirmed alerts from probe set, investigating tail latencies on pool-gpu-5. looks like kernel selection fallback caused extra memcpy on that host type.

amar: moving to investigate kernel selector logic and KV layout compatibility. will open a hotfix PR to avoid memcpy penalties and re-run canary once fixed.

jen: thanks — please update the release notes and pinlist doc with exemption entry for customer-x and the rollback rationale.

deploy-bot: r-8942 status: PAUSED, actions: rollback applied to pool-gpu-5, remaining hosts held. next steps: hotfix -> canary restart -> resume.
